reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and takeover shares unlink cleanup, although its transport functions copy existing implementations.

duplication.why: Link validation and cleanup are shared, but Fintegra duplicates the existing account-list request and transaction-download pipelines.

placement.why: Account orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The change primarily addresses the requested linking rules and provider integration, with an additional account-list endpoint and an unrelated schedule import reorder.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and unlink cleanup keep the rules understandable, but callers must coordinate validation before bank creation and maintain duplicated provider transport code.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link handlers use assertCanLinkBankAccount and linkBankSyncAccount; takeover and unlinkAccount both use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied fintegraAccounts and downloadFintegraTransactions implementations retain the existing structure rather than disguising it.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and nested flag/holder branches for takeover; these implement the requested variation without provider-specific bypasses.
